rules.title: Tenant Fee Responsibility for Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons
rules.requirement: Any fee for finding dwelling accommodations must be paid exclusively by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.

coverage.summary: Applies to real estate brokers and salespersons engaging with prospective tenants or landlords.

rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
